concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-au-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted AU-routed article for role-gated viewing of a selected merchant account's disbursement bank details and Control Panel submission of bank statements or signed bank letters for a new business checking account; upload is not acceptance or change-completion proof, and the page establishes neither an API update route nor a currency-specific account mapping
warnings: Keep this as a snapshot-scoped reciprocal route; do not infer current Australian policy, another merchant account's eligibility, or sibling-region behavior.
Do not turn the Control Panel document-upload instruction into proof of acceptance, approval, processing time, completion, or absence of API capability elsewhere.
The captured page names no settlement currency and does not establish a per-currency bank-account mapping.
